name: reportman-typescript
description: Report Manager in TypeScript: the npm packages of the report engine (pure JavaScript, no native code, no WebAssembly).

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/reportman-node packages/reportman-driver-postgres packages/reportman-driver-firebird packages/reportman-driver-mysql packages/reportman-driver-http packages/reportman-driver-mssql
scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/reportman-node packages/reportman-driver-postgres packages/reportman-driver-firebird packages/reportman-driver-mysql packages/reportman-driver-http packages/reportman-driver-mssql
